sections.Profile:
"Jungle Princess," a pinball machine released by Gottlieb in 1977, is a two-player version of "Jungle Queen." Designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison, this electro-mechanical game features a jungle theme with vibrant graphics. The machine includes four flippers, two kick-out holes, three pop bumpers, and two sets of five drop targets, but it notably lacks slingshots.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1977–1982
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Jungle, Original Theme, 1970s, Animals, Fantasy
